long_description:
At Dataleap we have one single focus - make knowledge work at your computer fun! Give all the other roles in sales, ops, hr the same super powers that engineers get with Cursor and Claude Code. 

Dataleap is the agentic operating system for the Enterprise. We enable business teams to automate they work without any help from engineering. No visual workflow builder, no hour long setup or steep learning curve in n8n. Build your AI coworkers in minutes with a fully agent first interface.
